plan.title: Extend live event window for vendor visibility

steps.note: Open the existing live event with an invited vendor.
Open the invited vendor's supplier session so its bidding view can be checked before and after the extension.
Open the vendor's live pricing round.
Return to the buyer's event page to extend the submission window.
Extend the live event's submission end by exactly 30 minutes and assert Procol saves the new end time.
Return to the vendor session after the buyer-side extension.
Reload the vendor's pricing round so the post-extension state is displayed.
Assert the vendor can still submit a quote after the window extension, which verifies bidding remains available.
